data.source_title: EHRGym: Epic-like EHR environment for training and evaluating computer-use agents
data.locator: README sections Clinical focus, What you get, Quickstart, and GRPO Training with TRL; repository license metadata
data.source_setting: Public GitHub software repository; synthetic EHR UI and browser-controlled OpenEnv environment, stated to be unaffiliated with Epic.
data.source_period: Repository snapshot observed 2026-10-10; repository is an actively changing public project.
data.source_evidence_basis: GitHub README describes a Next.js EHR, FastAPI/OpenEnv server with Playwright, synthetic patient pipeline, provider-oriented tasks, and Apache-2.0 license; it links to source directories and setup instructions.
data.limitations: README and license metadata establish what the repository documents and its stated open-source license, not that a clean install/build or hosted Space was independently run or that workflows match Epic or RWJBarnabas configuration. Do not equate this agent-computer-use environment with a validated human clinical training product or actual Epic software. Synthetic-only instruction is project guidance, not independent privacy/security certification.
data.inferred_scenario_use: Candidate sandbox for prototyping and scoring navigation, chart review, documentation, and order-workflow tasks with synthetic cases. Before use, inspect current source, dependency/license notices, scenario rubrics, hosted service controls, and reproducibility; require clinician review of any clinical rubric.

data.source_n: README claims 25 tasks: 8 basic, 9 medium, 8 hard.
data.quantity: Documented tasks and proposed evaluation metrics
data.source_evidence_basis: README lists the task counts and case types and proposes deterministic fixed-seed test suites and task/reward metrics.
data.limitations: These are repository README claims and proposed measurement dimensions, not independently reproduced benchmark results, validated clinical competency scores, or evidence of reduced patient harm. Task/rubric validity and annotation reliability are not established by the counts.
data.inferred_scenario_use: Use task counts only as a candidate scope estimate; define local competency outcomes and human-audited safety errors before comparing learner or model performance.
